plainTranslation: With Composite Jupiter in the 9th house, this is the house Jupiter naturally rules, so expansion and growth can be more natural for you together, and you can find it easier to be bolder and take risks together. You can have more opportunities for travel, learning, and growth in general. You can be more optimistic together than apart, and you can find more opportunities for big ideas with one another.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
